messages:
maya: hey team, first week q — I need access to console staging to validate a webhook flow and toggle a flag for an integration test. who should I ask? :wave:
ops: welcome @maya! ping ops and include your email. we usually grant 'console-staging-editor' for 24h for onboarding tests. what's your email?
maya: maya.chen@redwood.com
lena: hi @maya — if you toggle flags, please create a quick ENG-ONBOARD ticket with flag name, env, and test plan. we prefer canary groups not full-actor toggles.
onboarding-bot: welcome @maya! outstanding items: staging console access, jira setup, dev cluster kubeconfig. docs: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding
ops: granted 'console-staging-editor' until 24h from now. you should see roles in ~2m. note: toggles will be audited and require X-Operator header for API calls.
maya: I can see the workspace but /admin/flags returns 403 in UI.
sre-bot: 403 -> missing 'console-feature-editors' group. ops, can you confirm group membership?
ops: added maya to 'console-feature-editors' and cleared cache. try again in a minute.
maya: ok refreshed, can view flags and use the canary editor. quick curl example pls for scripted toggle?
lena: short example:
curl -X POST https://console.staging.internal/api/flags/patch -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Operator: maya.chen" -d '{"flag":"webhooks.delivery_fix","targets":[{"segment":"onboard_canary","value":true}]}'
maya: thanks — created ENG-ONBOARD-1310 with test plan and added @lena and @security.
security: approved export/read for telemetry. remember to scrub PII before any external upload. use infra-scrubper tool and tag exports 'onboard-test'.
maya: ran the test, toggled back, scrubbed logs, and attached results to ENG-ONBOARD-1310. all good! :white_check_mark:
lena: nice work. leaving a note in onboarding doc about the canary pattern.
onboarding-bot: milestone complete: staging access tasks for @maya finished."
